import Mathlib

theorem Opn.h3_test : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (2 ^ n - 1)) := by
  have hnn : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ (1 : ℝ) / (2 ^ n - 1) := by
    intro n
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ n := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    exact div_nonneg zero_le_one (by linarith)
  have hle : ∀ n : ℕ, (1 : ℝ) / (2 ^ n - 1) ≤ 2 * (1 / 2) ^ n := by
    intro n
    cases n with
    | zero => norm_num
    | succ k =>
      have hk : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ k := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
      have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ k := by positivity
      have h1 : (1 : ℝ) / (2 ^ (k + 1) - 1) ≤ 1 / 2 ^ k := by
        apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le hpos
        rw [pow_succ]; linarith
      have h2 : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ^ k = 2 * (1 / 2) ^ (k + 1) := by
        rw [one_div_pow, pow_succ]; field_simp
      rw [h2] at h1
      exact h1
  exact Summable.of_nonneg_of_le hnn hle (summable_geometric_two.mul_left 2)
